text.headline: Timeline of Vanuatu
text.text: Major events in the history of Vanuatu.

events.headline: Melanesian Settlement
events.text: Austronesian and Melanesian communities settle across the islands.

events.headline: European Discovery
events.text: Pedro Fernández de Quirós names the islands 'La Austrialia del Espíritu Santo.'

events.headline: Captain Cook Visits
events.text: Cook names the islands the New Hebrides.

events.headline: Anglo-French Condominium
events.text: France and Britain agree to jointly govern the New Hebrides.

events.headline: WWII & U.S. Bases
events.text: The islands host Allied bases during the Pacific war.

events.headline: Independence
events.text: Vanuatu achieves independence and joins the UN.

events.headline: Cyclone Pam
events.text: A powerful cyclone devastates infrastructure and communities.

events.headline: Climate Justice Leadership
events.text: Leads a UN campaign for climate justice.

events.headline: Resilience & Recovery
events.text: Focus on renewables and disaster resilience.
